justification: Both round-1 findings are fixed and nothing new broke. The 'Holds for' cells were also shortened to at most 29 characters ('Some input triggers it', 'All orderings equally likely', 'Any input, pivots randomized'), under the guide's ~30-char budget for a column meant to survive scrolling; on desktop (desktop-light-part09, desktop-dark-part09) all three columns sit comfortably in the column width with room to spare in both themes. This is a full reversal of the only major issue on record for this page. I checked every remaining screenshot pass for anything the writer's two targeted fixes might have disturbed and found nothing: mobileOverflowPx is 0, 0 console errors/warnings, 0 broken links (31 internal links, 8 external, all resolving), the single figure (two stacked partition trees, viewBox 360x622) still reads correctly in both themes with the 'empty left' annotation above its own dashed line and every node label legible at 390 px, all four exercises still use four different verb forms and stay collapsed by default with their output panels not spoiling the answer, heading levels are a flat, unbroken H2 run (8 sections, no H3 skipped down to or up from), and every other output panel (naive/randomized comparison table, hash-flood's hash/total-probes/per-key table) still keeps its columns inside about 40 characters. Lighthouse reproduced at 98/100/100/100 across three consecutive serial runs with an identical failing-audit set each time — no noise this session — comfortably clearing the ≥90-in-all-four-categories bar.
